999008199.text: 着いたぞ。見て分かる通り、ここが――

localizations.en: We've arrived. As you can see, this is—

999008199.text: ボスがしゃべってる途中なのに、失礼な雷です！

localizations.en: How rude of that lightning, interrupting the boss mid-sentence!

999008199.text: 自然現象に無理言っちゃダメだよ

localizations.en: You can't exactly blame a force of nature.

999008199.text:
『避雷のペンダント』は肌身離さず
持っていてくださいね？

localizations.en: Everyone, make sure you keep your Lightning Protection Pendant on you at all times, okay?

999008199.text:
なかなかよい意匠ですこと。
普段使いしても良さそうですわ

localizations.en: Quite an elegant design. I could wear this on a daily basis.

999008199.text:
なぁジェロンさん、俺らには綺麗すぎて
ちょっと似合わなそうだ

localizations.en: Hey Geron, don't these feel a bit too pretty for guys like us?

999008199.text:
そうだな。ティムはともかく……
だがこれも落雷対策だ、仕方あるまい

localizations.en: True. Tim aside... But it's for protection against lightning, so we'll just have to deal with it.

999008199.text:
対策しているとはいえ、危険なのは変わりない。
皆、気を付けて進むように

localizations.en: Even with countermeasures in place, this is still dangerous. Everyone, proceed with caution.

999008199.text:
おお、うるさいうるさい。
どうせなら耳栓も用意してくればよかったね

localizations.en: Ugh, so loud. We should've brought earplugs while we were at it.

999008199.text:
ハイディとジョゼは遊撃隊ね。
状況を判断して好きに動いてちょうだい

localizations.en: Heidi and José, you two are our mobile unit. Read the situation and act as you see fit.

999008199.text: ああ。俺は単独行動に慣れてるしね

localizations.en: Got it. I'm used to working solo anyway.

999008199.text:
私は何かあったときのために船で待機している。
タイニー、現場は任せたぞ

localizations.en: I'll stand by at the ship in case something happens. Tiny, the field is yours.

999008199.text:
はっ！　お任せください！
ボスの分まで、しっかり頑張ります！

localizations.en: Yes ma'am! Leave it to me! I'll work hard enough for both of us!

999008199.text: 配置、逆のほうがいい気もするんだけど……

localizations.en: I feel like those positions should be reversed...

999008199.text:
邪知に長けた罠があるかもしれません。
どんと構えた方が一人後詰めにいると、心強いので

localizations.en: There might be cunning traps waiting for us. Having someone with experience in reserve is reassuring.

999008199.text: 経験を活かして、的確に動いてみせよう

localizations.en: I'll put my experience to good use and act decisively.

999008199.text: ほら、仮面くん。私たちは別行動だよ

localizations.en: Come on, mask boy. We're splitting off.

999008199.text: そういえば雷って、どこに落ちるのかしら

localizations.en: Come to think of it, where does lightning strike?

999008199.text: 高い所とか、大きな金属に落ちやすいんですよ

localizations.en: It tends to strike high places and large metal objects.

999008199.text: さすがティム、詳しいな

localizations.en: That's my Tim. You really know your stuff.

999008199.text: ふーん、じゃあこうしてみたら……

localizations.en: Hmm, so if I try this...

999008199.text: ビ、ビビッた……！
ちょっとお前さん、大丈夫かい！？

え、ええ……
『避雷のペンダント』のおかげね

localizations.en: Y-Yes... Thanks to the Lightning Protection Pendant.

999008199.text:
実験で効果があるのは確認してるけど、
実際の雷相手にどれくらい持つか分からないから……

localizations.en: I've confirmed they work in experiments, but I don't know how long they'll hold up against actual lightning strikes...

999008199.text:
わざと雷を受けるなんて無茶はみんな、
やめてくださいね？

localizations.en: So please, everyone, don't do anything reckless like deliberately getting struck by lightning, okay?

999008199.text:
わ、分かったわ……
ごめんなさい
うちの愚妹が申し訳ない……

localizations.en: Sorry about my foolish little sister...

999008199.text:
はぁ、それにしても結局ヘルトと戦うんだもんなぁ。
……動きに気を付けないと……いざとなれば……

localizations.en: But man, we're really going to fight Held after all... I'll need to watch my movements... and if push comes to shove...
